crossRefs.note: He stood, and blessed all the assembly of Israel with a loud voice, saying,
“Blessed be Yahweh, who has given rest to his people Israel, according to all that he promised. There has not failed…
So Joshua blessed them, and sent them away; and they went to their tents.
When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of…
When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in Yahweh’s name.
The king turned his face, and blessed all the assembly of Israel: and all the assembly of Israel stood.
For a multitude of the people, even many of Ephraim, Manasseh, Issachar, and Zebulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet…
Blessed is he who comes in Yahweh’s name! We have blessed you out of Yahweh’s house.
He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands, and blessed them.
While he blessed them, he withdrew from them, and was carried up into heaven.
The priests stood, according to their positions; the Levites also with instruments of music of Yahweh, which David the…
Also Jeshua, Bani, Sherebiah, Jamin, Akkub, Shabbethai, Hodiah, Maaseiah, Kelita, Azariah, Jozabad, Hanan, Pelaiah, and…
The offspring of Israel separated themselves from all foreigners and stood and confessed their sins and the iniquities…
Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat, and sat, and all the multitude stood on the beach.
